meaning.vi: Có nhiều màu sắc khác nhau; lốm đốm.

sentences.en: The mountain regions are covered in evergreen laurel and heathered forests as well as extensive pine woods.

sentences.en: Feel free to unleash your inner disco diva with a pair of shiny lurex jeans, or opt for all out comfort with a heathered twill pant.

sentences.en: This "heathered" jersey pant and top is just another example of the different types of prima cotton lingerie you'll be able to find on this varied site.
